+import os, tempfile
+import numpy as np
+import torch
+from keras.src import layers, models, ops, tree
+from keras.src.export import export_torch
+
+tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
+
+def check(model, ref_inputs, args_for_call):
+    ref_out = model(ref_inputs) if args_for_call == "single" else model(*ref_inputs)
+    fp = os.path.join(tmp, "m.pt2")
+    out_fp = export_torch(model, fp, verbose=False)
+    assert out_fp == fp, out_fp
+    loaded = torch.export.load(fp)
+    if args_for_call == "single":
+        loaded_out = loaded.module()(_to_torch(ref_inputs))
+    else:
+        loaded_out = loaded.module()(*[_to_torch(x) for x in ref_inputs])
+    _compare(ref_out, loaded_out)
+    print("OK")
+
+def _to_torch(x):
+    if isinstance(x, dict):
+        return {k: torch.tensor(np.asarray(v)) for k,v in x.items()}
+    if isinstance(x, (list, tuple)):
+        return type(x)(torch.tensor(np.asarray(v)) for v in x)
+    return torch.tensor(np.asarray(x))
+
+def _compare(a, b):
+    a_flat = tree.flatten(a); b_flat = tree.flatten(b)
+    for x, y in zip(a_flat, b_flat):
+        x = np.asarray(ops.convert_to_numpy(x)); y = y.detach().numpy()
+        np.testing.assert_allclose(x, y, atol=1e-5, rtol=1e-5)

+m = models.Model(inp, out)
+check(m, np.random.rand(3,10).astype("float32"), "single")
+

+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.d1 = layers.Dense(8, activation="relu"); self.d2 = layers.Dense(2)
+    def call(self, x):
+        return self.d2(self.d1(x))
